Components.Content:
A pink bird loved by many, despite
its legs not being of optimal
condition due to _____

Array of Content:
Here is the flamingo that you 
are supposed to take care of!!!

You need to observe the current state of the 
animal so that you know the proper way to 
take care of them

right now the animal is in IDLE state, 
means that no extra care is needed 
for the animal currently

right now the animal is in HUNGRY state, 
means that you should feed the flamingo now!!!

You are supposed to drag this food to feed the
animal if it seemed like hungry

right now the animal is in SICK state, 
means that you should cure the flamingo now!!!

The red dot which is the painspot is appeared 
on the animal. You are supposed to click and drag this 
injection to inject on the red dot to heal the
animal if it seemed like sicked

right now the animal is in ANGRY state as it 
has been a long time that it cannot find its 
toy to entertain itself, so now you should 
find the toy that is hidden behind the scene to
calm it down!!!

Looks! You have successfully find the toy that
is hidden behind the scene and the flamingo does
not look angry anymore. In a real game scenario,
you have to observe where is the possible place
that the toy could be hidden inside and click on
suspicious spots to reveal the toy

Here is the log entry that gives clues about
the current status of the animal. You
can infer from the log info whether the animal
is IDLE/HUNGRY/SICKED/ANGRY state!!!

Here is the timer that indicates how long
you have been worked since the start of the game.

You can click on the button on the right side
to switch between different scenes

This number indicates how many secret keys you
have been revealed since the start of the game.
The game can be looked entirely different depends on how
many secret keys are found. All the keys are
hidden behind the scene as well like how the toy
works for the game but they are more hard to be found.

Congratulations!!! You have successfully complete
the tutorial level. Now you can move onto to
the actual gameplay level!!! ENJOY AND REMEMEBER
THE SECRET KEYS!!!
